## Problem and result
Describe the trigger, prior behavior and resulting behavior. Link issues.

## Evidence and scope
Source addresses/offsets, hashes and checkpoint links. Separate observations,
inferences, hypotheses and limitations. Identify research-only changes.

## Verification
Commands and results; asset-free vs private-fixture tests; DOS comparison vs
headless smoke vs actual desktop acceptance. Explain unrun checks/prerequisites.

## Preservation and publication
- [ ] Historical/frozen evidence and originals remain unchanged.
- [ ] No game assets/copies, raw dumps, prompt TXT files or secrets are included.
- [ ] Reviewed full staged diff and ran `python3 tools/audit_staged.py`.
- [ ] Relevant fmt/check/build/tests pass or limitations are explained.
- [ ] New dated checkpoint/living status updated when behavior/evidence changed.

## Remaining uncertainty and next step
Unknown behavior, contradictions, risks and follow-up work.
